race.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (Div 2)
race.verdict: GO VICTOR has taken his form up a notch in cheekpieces last 3 starts, winning twice before runner-up here on his latest outing. That was only his second run on all-weather and he is fancied to add to his tally, at the chief expense of the in-form Kings Merchant . Mr Dreamseller completes the shortlist. GO VICTOR (IRE) KINGS MERCHANT MR DREAMSELLER
